product_one_liner.value: CoLab is an AI-powered design-review platform for mechanical engineering and hardware-development teams to review CAD models and drawings, capture expert feedback, and automate design checks.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing or plan page was found; the site directs prospective buyers to sales.

employee_band.notes: The company describes a team of 250+; the company profile reports 281 employees, despite an inconsistent 51–200 company-size label.

eng_blog.notes: CTO Jeremy Andrews authored both articles: October 20, 2026 describes combining deterministic CAD geometry analysis with LLMs for CoLab’s DFM checks; June 12, 2026 discusses the engineering behind its CAD agents and design-verification approach.

public_docs.notes: Public help center includes user settings, product usage, review management, administration, and best-practice documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live opening: Senior 3D & AI Systems Software Developer.

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Cloudflare, and Datadog
model_provider.notes: These are the AI service providers explicitly listed by CoLab; no specific model version is identified on this page.

last_funding.notes: Latest listed financing is March 2026 debt financing, reported as US$728,000 in the company profile. The government announcement dated March 19, 2026 identifies a C$1 million repayable investment. The latest equity round was a US$72 million Series C announced November 10, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The US$72 million Series C announced November 10, 2025 falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live openings include Business Development Representative and Key Account Executive.

launched_6mo.notes: CoLab 4.0 launched July 9, 2026, including AutoReview 2.0, Operator early access, Canvas, Notebooks, and CAD integrations.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On May 6, 2026, CoLab announced Tom Greever joining as Senior Vice President of Design and Jessie Wheeler joining as Senior Vice President of Operations.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Revenue Operations Systems posting explicitly names these CRM, sales-engagement, conversation-intelligence, and enrichment systems; the BDR posting independently names Salesforce and Outreach.
